input.question: Which Mistral models support the FIM (fill-in-the-middle) feature?

content.text:
FIM (fill-in-the-middle) is supported by Mistral's **Codestral** model family, specifically:

- **Codestral 25-01** — [model card](https://docs.mistral.ai/models/codestral-25-01)
- **Codestral 25-08** — [model card](https://docs.mistral.ai/models/codestral-25-08)

Both specialize in low-latency, high-frequency coding tasks like FIM, code completion/correction, and test generation. You can query them via the FIM completion endpoint, as documented for e.g. [Outscale](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/cloud-deployments/outscale#querying-the-model-fim) and [Vertex AI](https://docs.mistral.ai/inference/deployment/cloud-deployments/vertex#querying-the-model-fim) deployments.
